title: Haven platform source-derived audit candidate register
method: Lexical discovery of source page/route/Edge entry points, literal .from/.rpc calls, storage/export helpers and CREATE TABLE declarations. Each row is an inventory candidate, not proven reachable or audited. SQL history is not a deployed catalog. Static matching is not a complete call graph. Shared helpers, dynamic names, SQL functions/triggers/policies, imports, jobs, direct Auth/PostgREST/storage and delegated pages require tracing and authenticated tests before HFA-005 or HFA-056 can pass.
limitations: No authenticated or production behavior tested by this inventory.
A required candidate may be classified inaccessible only with exact source and negative behavior evidence; financial/audit/privacy requirements cannot be waived.
All evidence sinks and business actor/scope rules remain unverified.
No live entity, accounting company, payroll provider or facility mapping inferred.
Source hashes capture potentially concurrent working tree at generated_at, not an assertion of clean commit parity.
required_test_dimensions: stable complete snapshot and recipient reauthorization
